findings.finding: Two edge cases, neither of which changes a result. (1) The fallback catches any ImportError raised while the predecessors are imported, not only a missing bare name. For example, a missing jsonschema inside native_qualification_v3 also triggers it. The fallback then fails too, and the traceback chain keeps the original cause, so the model never binds to the wrong modules silently. (2) When both scripts/ and the repository root are on sys.path, 'scripts.i06_backend_profile_v2' binds to the bare-named predecessors, so one process can hold two copies of v1 and W02a. All refusals are builtin exceptions, or jsonschema errors caught inside w02a.explain, and neither predecessor keeps mutable module state. My mixed-path replay (mode c) therefore gave identical results. The pattern matches validate_i06_backend_profile.py, validate_native_profile_v3.py and i07_policy_write.py, as the README says.
